title: Reschedule + meeting link permissions — propose Zoom temporary host
text:
Reschedule + meeting link permissions — propose Zoom temporary host

['From: Alex Cho <alex@stelia.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai, gina.ramos@stelia.com
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Demo today — join failing with SSO (403) / need reschedule

Hi Kimberly,

Quick heads-up: our security team blocked the Google Meet link you sent for the 10:00 PT demo — attendees hitting the join URL are seeing a 403 and an SSO error. We tried accepting the calendar invite from multiple accounts inside our org and it still fails.

We can still do the demo today if you can swap to Zoom (their SSO is allowing external Zoom links for us) or if you reissue the invite with a different organizer. Otherwise we need to push by a day.

Attendees: myself, Gina Ramos (ops), and our eng lead (Ken Park). Ken is on a tight schedule; if you can move to Zoom we can still make 30 mins later today.

Attached is a screenshot of the SSO error.

Thanks — sorry for the late notice.

—Alex
Alex Cho
Head of Product
Stelia Labs

Attachment: sso-403-screenshot.png (image/png, 98 KB)', 'From: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
To: Alex Cho <alex@stelia.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — join failing with SSO (403) / need reschedule

Hi Alex — thanks for the flag and the screenshot.

Sorry you're seeing that. We can absolutely pivot to Zoom and reissue the calendar invite. Two quick asks so I can coordinate ops:
- Do you want to keep the original 30-minute slot but start 30 mins later (10:30 PT), or move to tomorrow at the same time?
- If we switch to Zoom I will create the meeting and set Redwood as temporary host so your SSO won’t block the join flow. Ben, can you reissue the ICS and ensure the organizer is set to kimberly.park@redwood.ai (not our marketplace bot)?

Proposed next steps:
1) I create Zoom meeting and send new invite (proposed-times.ics).
2) Ben reissues the calendar event with updated organizer/ICS and adds a short note about host transfer.
3) Alex/Ken confirm acceptance and we do a 2-min pre-join test 5 mins before start.

If that works for you, reply with "Zoom and start 10:30 PT" or "Push to tomorrow".

Thanks — Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachment: proposed-times.ics (calendar/ics)', 'From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Cho <alex@stelia.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Sep 2026 08:49:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — join failing with SSO (403) / need reschedule

On Wed, Sep 2, 2026 at 08:37 AM kimberly.park@redwood.ai wrote:
> If that works for you, reply with "Zoom and start 10:30 PT" or "Push to tomorrow".

Thanks Kim — I can take this. I'll: 
- Create a Zoom meeting tied to a Redwood service account (host: host_claim@redwood.ai) so Stelia's SSO doesn't block organizer checks.
- Reissue the calendar invite and set the organizer to kimberly.park@redwood.ai in the ICS payload.
- Add a one-line host-transfer note in the event description with the temporary host email and a passcode (if required).

I will attach the new ICSs here and send the updated invite from kimberly.park@redwood.ai. Please confirm once Alex accepts so we can do the 2-min pre-join smoke test.

Attachments included: zoom-stitch.ics (calendar/ics), host-transfer-instructions.txt (text/plain)

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: zoom-stitch.ics (calendar/ics)
Attachment: host-transfer-instructions.txt (text/plain)', 'From: Alex Cho <alex@stelia.com>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.ai
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 3 Sep 2026 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo today — join failing with SSO (403) / need reschedule

Kimberly / Ben — Zoom worked perfectly, and we received the updated invite. Ken and I accepted the 10:30 PT slot.

We ran a quick click test and the join flowed through without the SSO block. All set on our side — see you at 10:30 PT.

Appreciate the fast pivot.

Best,
Alex
Alex Cho
Head of Product, Stelia Labs
